long_description.before:
X-ZELL™ is a global start-up specialising in rare cell detection technology. 

Backed by Y Combinator and various high-profile angel investors from around the globe – among them Gmail creator Paul Buchheit – X-ZELL™ has developed a world-first platform technology capable of isolating and visualizing rare and abnormal cells such as Circulating Endothelial Cells (CEC).

X-ZELL™’s platform technology is based on four core modules covering the entire spectrum from blood processing through to cell analysis and reporting – with every step performed in-house using patented and proprietary technology.

By combining the wisdom of 4,000 years of pathologic research with X-ZELL™’s own, cutting-edge technology, 
X-ZELL™ ensures robust results and maximum clinical utility across a broad range of medical applications – from research through to medication management, companions diagnostics, relapse control and diagnostic decision-making.

More information on www.x-zell.com and @XZELLInc
long_description.after:
Most cancer cases are not difficult to diagnose, only slow. A cytology sample such as pleural fluid or a fine-needle aspirate usually needs a panel of immunostains, which today means a cell block and up to two days of serial staining.

X-ZELL replaces that with Cryoimmunostaining™: direct-to-slide fixation and seven markers on one slide, read on a digital microscope, from sample to screen in under four hours. The platform (Cryofixator™, Cryostainer™, Hybrid Microscope and Cryophore™ panels) is CE-marked under the EU IVDR and in routine use at pathology laboratories in Germany.

X-ZELL is headquartered in Singapore. Its reagents are developed and manufactured in Bangkok, Thailand, under ISO 13485, next to an ISO 15189-accredited laboratory. The company was founded in 2014 by Dr Sebastian Bhakdi.

X-ZELL started with the detection of rare cells in blood. Bringing the same multiplex staining to routine cytology proved the faster route to patients, and that is where the company now focuses.

one_liner.after: Same-day cancer diagnosis from minimally invasive samples

long_description.before:

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair or, worse, an accident, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. long_description.before: At Okteto, we are working hard at creating the next-generation development experience for teams of all sizes. Have you ever seen how long it takes a developer to set up everything they need before working on a feature? We are fixing that.  We want developers to focus on building value for their teams instead of wasting time setting up local environments or trying to debug "production only" issues.
long_description.after:
Okteto gives every developer, coding agent and pull request an on-demand application environment on your own Kubernetes infrastructure.

Define your environment once, reusing your existing Helm, Compose or Kubernetes manifests, and use the same versioned definition across development, CI, previews and AI coding agents. Less configuration drift, less duplicated setup, and centrally managed access to clusters, registries and cloud resources.

Run coding agents on your cluster, batteries included. Launch them with Okteto's built-in orchestrator or bring your own, including agents running locally like Claude Code or Cursor, while Okteto manages the environments they build, deploy and test against. The agent stays small; the application runs in a real environment.

Your code meets Kubernetes earlier in the cycle. Every change gets automated tests against running services and a live preview URL that developers, QA and product managers can open without any local setup.

Built for platform teams that run environments at scale: Divert deploys only the services that change against a shared base, while automatic sleep, garbage collection, quotas and Smart Builds keep resource usage under control.

Self-hosted on your Kubernetes, including air-gapped clusters. SOC 2 Type 2 compliant.

one_liner.before: Cloud Development Environments with one click

all_locations.after: Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Bengaluru, KA, India

long_description.before:
Our mission: eradicate type 1 diabetes.
GloGlo is building an AI-native therapeutics company focused on accelerating the discovery of treatments that can prevent, stop, and ultimately cure type 1 diabetes.
We are developing AI research agents that continuously analyze scientific literature and biological datasets, generate and challenge hypotheses, design experiments, and run them in a wet lab to learn from experimental results.
We are building a tight "in silico <> in vitro/vivo" feedback loop that helps us identify better targets, run experiments more efficiently, and move faster toward therapies for type 1 diabetes.
long_description.after:
GloGlo is developing therapeutics that intercept autoimmune disease before the immune attack takes place.

Michael has lived with T1D for 17 years, conducted mathematics PhD research at Cambridge, and built a 70-person ML team acquired by Sonos. Anil Bhushan is a leading autoimmune disease researcher, tenured UCSF professor and founder of Deciduous Therapeutics. Marie is a repeat founder who sold Workwell to Mitsui Fudosan.

Their AI platform has identified de novo protein designs now undergoing wet lab validation, with mouse studies planned for early 2027. Initial indications are T1D and lupus, followed by multiple sclerosis and rheumatoid arthritis.

one_liner.after: Solving autoimmune diseases with AI, starting with type 1 diabetes.

long_description.before:
Paasa helps wealthy Indians invest in global equities - without middlemen, hidden fees, or paperwork.

While high-net-worths in India often have international expenses from children's education to healthcare, most still save in INR, a currency that depreciates ~2–5% per year against the USD. Why?

- Broken outward remittance process
- Fear of making mistakes in tax or compliance
- Paper-heavy onboarding processes of international brokers
- Lack of trustworthy guidance

Paasa offers a mobile app that enables Indians to trade worldwide, invest via advisory, and automate every cross-border tax filing.

long_description.before:
10x Science develops frontier AI models with deep memory to redefine how scientists understand and engineer biology across the life sciences, starting with drug development.

AI-powered drug discovery is flooding the pipeline with new candidates faster than ever. But before any of them can advance to the clinic, scientists must deeply characterize the protein therapeutic to understand whether it will work. Today, that process takes months of manual, error-prone analysis that cannot keep pace with discovery. Our AI-native platform automates it, giving drug developers the confidence to advance the right candidates and stop the wrong ones early.

We have strong commercial traction with enterprise pharma customers. Our founding team built the field of next-generation protein characterization out of Carolyn Bertozzi's Nobel laureate lab at Stanford. Collectively, we have 18+ years of collective domain expertise, 47+ scientific publications, and a 2x YC Founder. We move at the highest velocity and are positioned to lead the next generation of modern AI development in the life sciences.

long_description.after: Robots and servers need more power and data every year, and both still get it through tangles of cables and custom PCBs. A typical robot is a pile of boards wired together by hand, and every design change means waiting on a new board. SPITA is building networking for power. SPARC is a backplane with plug-in cards: drop in a chip or module, and software sets whether each pin carries power or data. Nothing needs rewiring or a new PCB. Once the design works, we export the schematic for production. We're starting with robotics teams, who can test new designs without spinning a board. Next is the server rack, where the same approach replaces today's cable-heavy backplanes.

one_liner.after: Networking for power and data in robots and servers
